title: Robust Harmful Meme Detection under Missing Modalities via Shared Representation Learning
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not analyze faith or religion. The benchmark measures the harmfulness of memes, specifically in the context of COVID-19 (Harm-C dataset) and politics (Harm-P dataset).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as this was not a focus of the study.
